record.frame: Pollen's mesh frame for upper_leg_left.stl: X = cup depth (open face 42.5, plate inner face 69.5, back face 70.5), Y = width -13.47..34.19, Z = length -12.2..48.8. Servo axes A0 = (y 0, z 0) hip pitch and A1 = (y 22, z 35.777) knee, both along +x. Kept so the MJCF geom pos (0,0,-42.5) quat (0.5,-0.5,-0.5,-0.5) places it directly.

interfaces.name: hip_pitch_axle
interfaces.what: On the outside of the back plate at the hip-pitch axis: Ø5.37 counterbore 2.5 deep (x 70.5 -> 68.0) over a Ø2.4->2.8 through hole (a slight cone, 3.3 long) through the Ø4.42 boss on the inside. The screw that pins the servo's rear axle/idler to the housing seats here. M2 vs M2.5 is CANNOT DETERMINE from a 2.4-2.8 mm hole in a decimated mesh; the community reads the whole robot as an M2 system.
interfaces.source: MEASURED off Pollen's mesh 2026-09-01: cecad.meshfeatures hole Ø5.371 at (69.25, 0, 0) length 2.5; cecad.meshslice ray probe A (r 1.1 empty, r 1.2-1.4 material 64.7->65.7/67.6/68.0, r 2.7 -> 69.5, r 2.8 -> 70.5)

interfaces.name: knee_axle
interfaces.what: Identical to hip_pitch_axle, at the knee axis 42.000 mm away: Ø5.37 x 2.5 counterbore, Ø2.4->2.8 through.
interfaces.source: MEASURED off Pollen's mesh 2026-09-01: cecad.meshfeatures hole Ø5.371 at (69.25, 22, 35.777); meshslice probe A ('hip +y' column) identical to A0 at every radius

interfaces.name: hip_pitch_servo_seat
interfaces.what: Inside the cup at the hip-pitch axis: a stepped boss standing 4.8 mm off the plate's inner face — Ø7.27 from x 69.5 to 67.0, then Ø4.42 from 67.0 to 64.7 — with the axle hole through its centre. The Ø4.42 step is what enters the XL330's rear; the screw named at hip_pitch_axle passes through it. Which XL330 rear feature it engages is CANNOT DETERMINE without a servo in hand.
interfaces.source: MEASURED off Pollen's mesh 2026-09-01: cecad.meshfeatures bosses Ø7.268 at x 68.25 (length 2.5) and Ø4.417 at x 65.85 (length 2.3); meshslice probe A (r 2.1 -> 64.7..68.0, r 2.3-2.6 -> 67.0..68.0, r 3.5 -> 67.0..70.5, r 3.7 -> 69.5..70.5)

interfaces.name: knee_servo_seat
interfaces.what: Identical to hip_pitch_servo_seat at the knee axis.
interfaces.source: MEASURED off Pollen's mesh 2026-09-01: same features at (x, 22, 35.777)

interfaces.name: pin_1
interfaces.what: Ø1.6->1.8 x 2.0 pin (x 64.5..66.5) on a '+' boss (hub Ø1.9, arms 0.8 wide x 2.9 long, x 66.5..69.5) standing on the plate's inner face. 1.6 mm is the minor diameter of an M2 thread: the pin locates the knee XL330's rear M2 hole; the rigidity plate's Ø2.2 hole sits on the same (y, z) 21 mm away at x 43. The pin is solid (centre ray: material 64.5..70.46, no hole).
interfaces.source: MEASURED off Pollen's mesh 2026-09-01: meshslice probes B/H/M (pin r 0.8 -> 64.59, r 0.85 -> 65.55, r 0.9 -> 66.5; arm half-width 0.35..0.4, arm end 2.9..2.95)

interfaces.name: pin_2
interfaces.what: As pin_1; full four-arm cross. With pin_1 it is 16.0 mm apart along z, both 22.5 mm from the knee axis along -y: the knee servo's rear hole pair.
interfaces.source: MEASURED off Pollen's mesh 2026-09-01: meshslice probe H/M at (-0.5, 27.777)

interfaces.name: pin_3
interfaces.what: As pin_1; three arms (-y, +z, -z). With pin_4 it is 16.0 mm apart along y, both 22.5 mm from the hip-pitch axis along +z: the hip-pitch servo's rear hole pair.
interfaces.source: MEASURED off Pollen's mesh 2026-09-01: meshslice probe H at (-8, 22.5): +y arm absent (d 1.0 -> 68.4), -y arm to 2.8

interfaces.name: pin_4
interfaces.source: MEASURED off Pollen's mesh 2026-09-01: meshslice probe H at (8, 22.5): -y arm absent, +y arm to 2.8
